title: Amit Shah arrives in Punjab, to meet Parvinder Singh Jhota’s kin
summary: Hours before the visit, Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann said his government has decided to hand over the Jhota murder case to the CBI

title: CMRL-Exalogic payoff case: RMP, outside ally of ruling UDF in Keralam, opposes govt stand in HC
summary: K.K. Rema says government stand ‘undermines its declared position on corruption’

title: Tamil Nadu government orders additional 25 days of guaranteed employment for vulnerable rural households
summary: The ‘Vetri 150’ scheme, sanctioned with ₹100 crore for 2026-27, extends VB-G RAM G’s guaranteed employment to 150 days for women-headed, SC/ST and other vulnerable households

title: DMK councillor booked for ‘defamatory’ remarks against Tamil Nadu CM Vijay
summary: The complainant alleged that Sudha Deenadayalan, the DMK councillor representing Ward 95 in the Villivakkam area, allegedly used objectionable language against the Chief Minister.

title: U.P. Panchayat poll: Is BJP looking to bypass the semi final?
summary: The Allahabad High Court’s directive to the Uttar Pradesh government and the State Election Commission (SEC) to complete the three-tier panchayat elections within three months has sparked conversations in village chaupals

title: Tiger Shroff firing incident: Mumbai Police take custody of three arrested in Kota; Bishnoi gang link under probe
summary: According to Kota Police, the suspects were allegedly planning to escape to Nepal via Delhi; Mumbai Police DCP (Detection) Raj Tilak Roshan clarified that none of the three accused were minors

title: Bengal Fire Services Department issues notices to three Kolkata Durga Puja committees over safety lapses
summary: During inspections, officials also stressed the need for adequate lighting and ventilation inside pandals to prevent dark spots, ensure visibility and facilitate crowd management

title: From death row to award-winning author, C. Selvam expresses remorse, reflects on the families of his victims
summary: Oru Thooku Kaithiyin Vaakumoolam, a prison memoir by the death-row convict, has been selected for the Iyal Award, which is instituted by the Canada-based Tamil Literary Garden
